a file operation that cannot complete (missing or unopenable file, unwritable target) answers its own failure value - a read null, a write a FileResult other than Ok, exists false - and continues, never a runtime error; paths.md (Path-Refuse states this only for refused paths)

pass-2 refusal catalogue: argument/return/branch types checked against what is expected; a par worker's first argument is the loop element and the par form refuses what the sequential call refuses

build/remove cycles over vector, sorted, index and hash: removals by key or #remove leave the rest reachable and counted, a missing-key removal is a no-op, index order id ascending then name descending

a type, function or enum means the same wherever in the file (or in which imported package) it is declared relative to its uses - a for over a forward vector<struct> field, a match on a forward enum, a forward struct literal and inline field all answer as if declared first; grammar.md (the two-pass property, @FTR-073)
negative slice bounds count from the end on either side, inclusive and open forms, for-loop over a negative slice, reversed empty; single negative index
a nullable narrow field whose range fills its width (limit(0,255)?, limit(-128,127)?, limit(0,65535)?) round-trips null and both extremes

a no-warning smoke tour over unrelated constructs (filtered #remove, unused loop vars, early returns, if-else values, nested structs, file exists/write to a missing dir); each check is incidental, nothing pins a rule's statement
const fields: construction sets them, contents mutation and append through a binding-const field stay legal, a value-const field may be rebound, variant fields enforce alike

a null of every type kind (scalar, character, text, struct, vector, value enum, nullable narrow field) round-trips through returns, if arms and fields; boolean null is raw under == and false under !; ?? falls to the default
size(t) is the UTF-8 byte count of t (len(t) its codepoint count): 5 for hello, 6 for an accent, 9 for three CJK characters, 4 for an emoji; iteration.md beside I-Text or types.md

delete/mkdir/rmdir/move answer a classified FileResult (NotFound, IsDirectory, NotEmpty, Other); a .. path means what it says (loft#712); the FileResult classification itself has no rule (see File-Fail)
stdlib aggregate smoke (sum_of shim, min_of, max_of values); a library API, no formal rule states it
